current.text: He is a rookie. Dallas took him in the first round, in the 20s.
Josh projects him as the backup point guard. He sees him as worth watching when Kyrie Irving sits, with a possible line of 10 points and 5 assists in 27 minutes.
In Summer League he averaged almost 8 to 9 assists. He shot under 30% and struggled to create his own shot.
Dallas is short on true ball handlers. The only real guards are Kyrie Irving, de Larrea and Marcus Sasser. Kyrie is 36 and coming off injury.
Dallas plays 4 games in each of our fantasy playoff weeks (4-4-4). It also has a league-high 16 back-to-backs.
Yahoo projects a small role and ranks him 615th, so he is not a draft pick in a 144-player league. He is a waiver watch for nights when Kyrie sits.

durable.text: He is a 6'7 point guard who dribbles and passes well. He was probably the best passer at Summer League.
Some experts still worry about his shooting.
